title: Larval beetle jumps — Bertone et al. 2022, PLOS ONE
citation: Bertone M.A. et al. (2022). A novel power-amplified jumping behavior in larval beetles (Coleoptera: Laemophloeidae). PLOS ONE 17(1): e0256509. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0256509 — files: paper PDF, S1 Video, S2 Video, S1 Table (xlsx), S2 File (zip with the authors' R script and raw tracks).
licence: CC BY 4.0 (article and supplementary files) — reused with attribution; overlays added by Pixels to Proof.
note: The overlap with the published value is narrow, at the low end of our interval. Our grid gives 5.0 mm squares; the authors' own scale implies about 4.85 mm, a 3% difference that moves the estimate by the same amount. The second reading is the authors' stated method (a smoothing spline of the cumulative path, maximum of its derivative), approximately replicated on our track; it is printed for comparison and does not decide. Passing the self-checks shows the flight is physically consistent; it does not prove the number exact.
